method: Grades marked "Script:" were recomputed by tools/grade.py from the packages as they are now (contrast, token provenance, the README's Do and don't list, and DESIGN.md freshness). Criteria a capture cannot meet are graded not applicable (see each criterion). Every other grade comes from the review that last set it (each package's reviewed date, else the 2026-10-16 review): Hevy's reviewed grades come from the 2026-10-16 review: five Sonnet agents applied the fixed rubric to each package's README, tokens, components.md and DESIGN.md, ran the library's contrast and DESIGN.md checks, and wrote one grade plus a short evidence note per criterion. The twelve packages recaptured on 2026-10-17 were re-reviewed that day by twelve independent Opus agents, one per package, grading from the package files without seeing the stored grades; every grade that differed was then checked against the files. The same calls were applied to every package: ranges in a done-when rule (6 to 8 type sizes, 3 to 5 shadow levels) are applied as written; a role filled by a derived or reassigned token for something the product does not draw counts as partly; a whole criterion the product lacks is not applicable; every shadow level must be tied to a use; and a README claim the files contradict caps the package entry at partly.

reviewMethod: Hevy's reviewed grades come from the 2026-10-16 review: five Sonnet agents applied the fixed rubric to each package's README, tokens, components.md and DESIGN.md, ran the library's contrast and DESIGN.md checks, and wrote one grade plus a short evidence note per criterion. The twelve packages recaptured on 2026-10-17 were re-reviewed that day by twelve independent Opus agents, one per package, grading from the package files without seeing the stored grades; every grade that differed was then checked against the files. The same calls were applied to every package: ranges in a done-when rule (6 to 8 type sizes, 3 to 5 shadow levels) are applied as written; a role filled by a derived or reassigned token for something the product does not draw counts as partly; a whole criterion the product lacks is not applicable; every shadow level must be tied to a use; and a README claim the files contradict caps the package entry at partly.
